svg.title: The few that carry the value
svg.desc: Three practices reach the reader: leading with the task, code that copies and runs, and a documentation update in every feature pull request. Two more, a style guide and a content calendar, are drawn muted inside a cluster labelled ceremony and do not connect to the reader, because they only matter once the first three are in place.
svg.text: // THE FEW THAT CARRY THE VALUE
